description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing messages and announcements in the Notesnook mobile app, including functions for setting, removing, and filtering announcements based on user status and platform.

methods.name: useMessageStore
methods.description: Creates a Zustand store for managing message and announcement state, including methods to set messages, remove announcements, and fetch filtered announcements.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Filters announcements based on whether they should be shown to the current user and platform.

methods.name: shouldShowAnnouncement
methods.description: Determines if a specific announcement should be shown based on platform, app version, user subscription status, and user email verification.
